additional_info.subject: ID0441955-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP/S3 170003388] DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 error CRM:02889000376
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin,
I checked the charger via SSH and found that the values are very high:
Please measure the resistance from the cable itself, if it's this enormous value, then please replace the cable.
Otherwise please measure until the KF13 to see where it drops.
If you measure 1kOhm until the StateMonitor and still the error is present please try replacing the grey connector from the KF13 or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take CCS cable and KF13 as spare parts.
Thank you!
BEst regards,
Francisco
